title: Mendelssohn House, Leipzig

buildingCutout.basis: The separate masks replace the named house and garden house while leaving the area between them open.

terrainReference.basis: Original sampled elevation on Goldschmidtstraße in front of the house.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap Mendelssohn-Haus and associated garden building, confirmed by Saxony heritage register 09290143.
mapIdentity.scope: The named mapped Mendelssohn-Haus way 239961680 and museum garden-house way 70288358 correspond to the standing house and rear building in Saxony heritage entry 09290143. The neighboring apartment buildings are separate.

note: Saxony records an 1844–45 plaster and sandstone house with a later street shop, memorial plaque and court house. The 1900 Payne-edition illustration and 2024 creator-released courtyard photograph give the characteristic tiers, arched windows, corbels and the red dormered garden roof.
